1.1.1.description:
mostly bugfixes and apworld housecleaning
 - fix issue where this game's "Non-Matching ROM error" will show up when youre trying to play a completely different game entirely
 - added more complete regions for checks
 - fix issue where the first level of Let's Shop mode could still be attempted when 0 shopping levels were unlocked
   - For now, the game will just set the timer to 0 if it detects that the player has done this. this is one of those things that ASM hacking will be great for
 - fixed an issue where the saved bonus count didnt get cleared when setting up for a new AP
 - all bonuses, including Extra bonuses from the multiworld and natural bonuses that you get from recipe step minigames, are now cleared upon recipe completion if all bonus checks have been obtained
   - Bonuses are entirely useless in this AP after you get the checks, so this is to make playing the game less annoying
1.1.1.title: Cooking Mama 3 AP v1.1.1
